title: Woodworking Machine Setters, Operators, and Tenders, Except Sawing
description: Set up, operate, or tend woodworking machines, such as drill presses, lathes, shapers, routers, sanders, planers, and wood nailing machines. May operate computer numerically controlled (CNC) equipment.

tasks.text: Set up, program, operate, or tend computerized or manual woodworking machines, such as drill presses, lathes, shapers, routers, sanders, planers, or wood-nailing machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Woodworking equipment needs dexterity and material feel

dwas.name: Operate woodworking equipment.

tasks.text: Examine finished workpieces for smoothness, shape, angle, depth-of-cut, or conformity to specifications and verify dimensions, visually and using hands, rules, calipers, templates, or gauges.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on dimensional measurement of workpieces

dwas.name: Measure dimensions of completed products or workpieces to verify conformance to specifications.
dwas.gwa_name: Estimating the Quantifiable Characteristics of Products, Events, or Information

tasks.text: Start machines, adjust controls, and make trial cuts to ensure that machinery is operating properly.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating production equipment physically on site

dwas.name: Conduct test runs of production equipment.
Operate woodworking equipment.

tasks.text: Monitor operation of machines and make adjustments to correct problems and ensure conformance to specifications.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical product flaw monitoring is on-machine

dwas.name: Monitor equipment operation to ensure that products are not flawed.

tasks.text: Examine raw woodstock for defects and to ensure conformity to size and other specification standards.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Lumber inspection requires physical handling

dwas.name: Inspect lumber or raw woodstock.

tasks.text: Adjust machine tables or cutting devices and set controls on machines to produce specified cuts or operations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control setting for cutting

dwas.name: Set equipment controls to meet cutting specifications.

tasks.text: Install and adjust blades, cutterheads, boring-bits, or sanding-belts, using hand tools and rules.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control setting for cutting

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.
Set equipment controls to meet cutting specifications.

tasks.text: Change alignment and adjustment of sanding, cutting, or boring machine guides to prevent defects in finished products, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical control setting for cutting

dwas.name: Set equipment controls to meet cutting specifications.

tasks.text: Determine product specifications and materials, work methods, and machine setup requirements, according to blueprints, oral or written instructions, drawings, or work orders.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Input material selection from specs; human approves

dwas.name: Determine production equipment settings.
Select production input materials.

tasks.text: Feed stock through feed mechanisms or conveyors into planing, shaping, boring, mortising, or sanding machines to produce desired components.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Feeding materials into equipment is physical

dwas.name: Feed materials or products into or through equipment.

tasks.text: Push or hold workpieces against, under, or through cutting, boring, or shaping mechanisms.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Maneuvering workpieces needs hands-on control

dwas.name: Maneuver workpieces in equipment during production.

tasks.text: Select knives, saws, blades, cutter heads, cams, bits, or belts, according to workpiece, machine functions, or product specifications.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Equipment selection against specs; human verifies fit

dwas.name: Select production equipment according to product specifications.

tasks.text: Remove and replace worn parts, bits, belts, sandpaper, or shaping tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on removal and fitting of worn components

dwas.name: Remove accessories, tools, or other parts from equipment.
Replace worn equipment components.

tasks.text: Secure woodstock against a guide or in a holding device, place woodstock on a conveyor, or dump woodstock in a hopper to feed woodstock into machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting workpieces is physical loading

dwas.name: Load materials into production equipment.
Mount materials or workpieces onto production equipment.

tasks.text: Inspect and mark completed workpieces and stack them on pallets, in boxes, or on conveyors so that they can be moved to the next workstation.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Marking workpieces is hands-on physical task

dwas.name: Mark products, workpieces, or equipment with identifying information.
Stack finished items for further processing or shipment.

tasks.text: Inspect pulleys, drive belts, guards, or fences on machines to ensure that machines will operate safely.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical inspection of production machinery in situ

dwas.name: Inspect production equipment.

tasks.text: Clean or maintain products, machines, or work areas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical production equipment maintenance

dwas.name: Clean work areas.
Clean production equipment.
Maintain production or processing equipment.

tasks.text: Attach and adjust guides, stops, clamps, chucks, or feed mechanisms, using hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mounting tools requires hands-on setup

dwas.name: Mount attachments or tools onto production equipment.
Set equipment guides, stops, spacers, or other fixtures.

tasks.text: Trim wood parts according to specifications, using planes, chisels, or wood files or sanders.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual trimming of workpieces

dwas.name: Trim excess material from workpieces.

tasks.text: Grease or oil woodworking machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual lubrication of production equipment

dwas.name: Lubricate production equipment.

tasks.text: Unclamp workpieces and remove them from machines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically extracting parts from production equipment

dwas.name: Remove products or workpieces from production equipment.

tasks.text: Start machines and move levers to engage hydraulic lifts that press woodstocks into desired forms and disengage lifts after appropriate drying times.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Woodworking equipment needs dexterity and material feel

dwas.name: Operate woodworking equipment.

tasks.text: Operate gluing machines to glue pieces of wood together, or to press and affix wood veneer to wood surfaces.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Woodworking equipment needs dexterity and material feel

dwas.name: Operate woodworking equipment.

tasks.text: Set up, program, or control computer-aided design (CAD) or computer numerical control (CNC) machines.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Programming production equipment needs physical setup and verification

dwas.name: Program equipment to perform production tasks.

tasks.text: Control hoists to remove parts or products from work stations.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Crane/hoist operation demands real-time physical control

dwas.name: Operate cranes, hoists, or other moving or lifting equipment.
